authorization: Continue investigation; one mechanism control motivated by prior diagnostic, not independent confirmation
treatment: Select original Q5 at phase1 signal close, hold that fixed membership list, execute at phase2 next-market open; initial Jan8 shared, next phases from February. No replacement with later scores.
membership: At later signal remove names no longer current members, no replacement; equal-weight remaining fixed names; actual blocked sells/buys unchanged
contrasts: A=phase1 immediate, B=phase1 fixed basket delayed to phase2, C=phase2 fresh basket. A-B timing-and-holding-path effect, B-C earlier-vs-later selection at same execution clock; not causal economic mechanism.
comparison: primary end min(2025-03-03, available end of all 27 A/B/C costs/models); plus each model shared full available end; all initial fees retained
statistics: descriptive paired 65-session time-block 2000 replicate intervals; posthoc, not confirmatory
